title: Android EMI Payment Locker
desc:
I need an Android-only locker application that can remotely lock a customer’s phone whenever an EMI payment is missed. The lock itself will be triggered manually from an admin dashboard once my finance team confirms non-payment; there is no need for automated date checks on the device.  

Core flow: the customer installs the app during onboarding, grants all required device-owner permissions, and keeps it running quietly in the background. If a payment is missed, I log in to the web-based admin panel, select the user’s device, and send the lock command. The device should then display a full-screen blocking view that prevents normal use until I issue an unlock command after payment is received.  

Because the sole purpose is payment enforcement, traditional locker extras such as file storage, password managers, or photo vaults are not required. Instead, I want the build to focus on: reliable remote locking, tamper resistance (e.g., uninstall protection, block Settings access), and a lightweight footprint so the customer’s phone performance is unaffected when the device is in good standing.  

Please deliver:  
• Android app (targeting current API level with backward compatibility to Android 8)  
• Secure admin web panel or small REST service with simple UI to lock/unlock users  
• Documentation covering installation, required permissions (Device Administrator / Device Owner), and the lock-unlock API calls  

A short demo video or screen recording that proves the lock, unlock,

title: Studio Shoot for Apparel Drop
desc:
We need a photographer in Dublin for a concise, one-hour studio session at 50hz Studio on the evening of July 29th to showcase MYTH’s latest apparel drop. The setting is a clean white-room studio where several models will rotate through individual, group, and close-up clothing poses. The resulting images will anchor our upcoming promotional material, and we want a polished, commercially styled look that still feels authentic to an underground music and nightlife brand.

You’ll direct the lighting and composition, shoot tethered if possible so we can review on the spot, and deliver fully edited, high-resolution files ready for print, web, and social. Please tell me about similar commercial work you’ve handled—your experience is the deciding factor for us. We are specifically looking for someone with extensive photo shoot experience, a high-quality camera, and the ability to deliver files in correct formats and ratios.

Key deliverables:  
• Approximately 30–40 final retouched images (mix of portrait, landscape, and detail shots)  
• Colour-corrected, cropped, and exported in both web-optimised and full-res formats within five days of the shoot  

The studio and models are booked; you just bring your camera kit, lighting know-how, and creative eye. Looking forward to seeing how your experience can elevate this drop.

title: Tally Postings for Family Accounts
desc:
I need the last two financial years of my family’s personal accounts posted neatly inside Tally. There are only five to six ledgers involved and, on average, each ledger holds about fifteen transactions per year—so the work is light but must be precise.  

All entries should follow the Standard Tally format so that I can open the file and run my usual reports without extra tweaks. I will supply the raw data (bank statements and notes) in the order you’ll need; you simply key them in, reconcile totals, and share back the updated Tally data file along with a quick PDF export of the ledger and daybook for each year so I can review.  

Accuracy matters more than speed, but I would like both years wrapped up quickly so I can move on to tax preparation. If anything looks off balance, flag it and confirm with me before finalising.

title: Fintech Expense Tracker UI/UX Design
desc:
I’m building a mobile-first productivity app with a clear Fintech twist: it centres on personal expense tracking. I already have a feature list and a rough user flow, but the screens are still only sketches. Your task is to translate those ideas into a clean, intuitive UI and a friction-free UX that makes logging, viewing and analysing daily spending feel effortless.

Here’s what I need from you:  
• Low-fidelity wireframes that map the full expense-tracking journey—from adding receipts to visualising trends.  
• A consistent design system (colour, type, iconography) suitable for light and dark mode.  
• High-fidelity, clickable prototypes in Figma (or Sketch/Adobe XD if you strongly prefer).  
• Handoff-ready assets and style-guides so my developers can implement the designs without guesswork.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Every primary action can be completed within three taps.  
2. Data-heavy screens (charts, summaries) must remain readable on 5.5–6.7" devices.  
3. All components pass WCAG AA contrast ratios.

I’ll share full user stories, branding references and a Trello board once we start. If you’re a fresh designer eager to showcase solid mobile Fintech skills, this project will give you a polished portfolio piece.

title: Lead Generation Landing Domains
desc:
I need a fresh .com domain secured and hosted, then spun into a network of focused landing pages—one root domain plus dedicated sub-domains for HVAC, Auto Insurance, Pest Control, Water Damage, Roofing, Plumbing, and Final Expense. Each page must share a modern, clean aesthetic that feels unified yet tailored to its niche.

Core content on every page will be a concise service description paired with an easy-to-use contact form. The primary call-to-action is “Schedule a consultation,” so the layout should naturally steer visitors toward that button without clutter or distraction.

Please wire the entire setup to Google Ads Manager (or the ad manager we specify) so we can track conversions and pass lead data straight into our US-based call-center workflow. I’m not migrating the existing corporate site; this project is a stand-alone lead engine on its own domain name.

Deliverables
• Register or suggest an available .com and configure DNS  
• Stand-up seven sub-domains, each with its own landing page  
• Responsive, modern & clean design, fast load times  
• Contact form on every page, routed to our chosen email/CRM  
• Single CTA: “Schedule a consultation,” with event tracking in Ad Manager  
• Basic on-page SEO (titles, meta, schema where relevant)  
• Final hand-off with all source files and login credentials

If you’ve built similar multi-landing setups—especially for lead gen—let me see them when you bid.

title: Cartoonesque Anime Manga Illustrator Needed
desc:
The entire 300-350 page story is already scripted and each principal character comes with written notes plus AI-generated reference sheets; what I need now is your hand to transform that groundwork into finished sequential art.  

Mood & Themes  
The narrative stays firmly on the serious, dramatic side and tackles mental health and well-being, societal and cultural pressures, and personal growth through often uncomfortable territory. Your own sensitivity to these subjects is essential, as the illustrations must respect the weight of every scene without slipping into exploitation.  

Visual Expectations  
I picture moderately detailed, clean lines—think clear panel composition that keeps the pace moving while still allowing emotion to breathe. If you work comfortably in Clip Studio Paint or a similar digital toolset, all the better; layered files will streamline our revision passes.  

Workflow & Deliverables  
• Rough thumbnails or page layouts in manageable batches for early feedback  
• Clean line art (black-and-white; tones optional at a later stage) delivered as layered PSD or CSP files at print-ready resolution  
• Final export of each page (TIFF or high-quality PNG) once approved  

I’m open to discussing a milestone schedule—perhaps every 10–15 pages—so we both stay on track. If the collaboration clicks, the page count can expand beyond the initial estimate. Share a portfolio piece that best reflects a cartoonesque, anime-inspired style with strong storytelling chops,

title: Creative Performance Music Video
desc:
I'm looking for a talented videographer to create a performance-style music video for a radio track. The video should incorporate lifestyle-themed abstract elements. 

Key Requirements:
- Capture dynamic performance shots
- Integrate lifestyle abstract elements
- Shoot both indoors and outdoors

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Experience with performance music videos
- Strong creative vision for lifestyle integration
- Proficient in handling indoor and outdoor shoots

Please provide a portfolio with relevant work.

title: Urgent Italian (Italy) Native Speakers Needed – Dual Recording Project
desc:
We are looking for 2 native Italian (Italy) speakers to complete a simple recording project.

Requirements:

Both participants must be native Italian (Italy) speakers.
Record a natural conversation via Zoom.
Each participant must record their own audio locally using Easy Voice Recorder (Android) or a similar app.
Upload the recordings to Google Drive and share the folder with us.

Payment: $80 per pair
Urgent: The project must be completed and submitted today.

If you already have a partner and can start immediately, please send me a message.

title: Traditional Chinese Food & Culinary Culture Adaptation
desc:
I have short English texts about traditional Chinese food culture, cooking methods, and culinary traditions. I need them adapted into natural, clear Chinese that feels authentic and readable.
This is not about restaurant menus or dish lists. The content focuses on cultural background, traditional practices, regional food customs, and the meaning behind certain cooking methods.
What I'm Looking For

Native Simplified Chinese speaker
Familiarity with Chinese food culture and traditions
Ability to write natural and clear Chinese
Good attention to detail

Sample Task (include in your proposal)
Adapt the following short English text into natural Chinese. Show your full adapted version in your bid.
Original Text:
In many parts of China, the way food is prepared and shared reflects deep cultural values. Traditional cooking methods are often passed down through generations, and certain ingredients carry symbolic meaning during important family gatherings and seasonal celebrations.
Deliverables

One clean Word document with the adapted Chinese versions
Natural and culturally appropriate Chinese
Final version only

Acceptance Criteria

The Chinese version reads naturally
Original meaning and cultural context are preserved
Tone is suitable for cultural or educational content
Work is clear and professional


Provide your Chinese version of the sample text above
Confirm you are a native Simplified Chinese speaker
Mention any familiarity with Chinese food culture

title: 400 Licensed Sewing & Crochet PDFs
desc:
I need a ready-to-sell bundle of at least 400 unique PDF patterns. Sewing patterns are my priority, but I’ll also welcome crochet files that cover baby items, hats, scarves, bags, shawls, Christmas, and other seasonal themes. Every file must include both detailed written instructions and visual guides in the same PDF.

What I must receive
• A minimum of 400 well-organized PDFs (sewing first, crochet optional).  
• Proven PLR, MRR, or other commercial resale licenses that allow me to list the files on Etsy, Shopify, and my own site.  
• Written proof of rights for each pattern—no copyrighted or scraped material.  
• A short sample set so I can review quality and confirm licensing before final purchase.  
• Fast delivery via a clearly labeled folder structure.

If you already own a legally resellable library that matches these requirements, let’s talk.
